## Fixed

- **The search bar's assistant button opens the assistant.** It opened the Google app, which shows its feed. It now brings up Gemini, Google Assistant or whichever assistant is set, as holding the home button does. The "Open assistant" gesture does the same.
- **The dock search bar searches Google.** A Hyperion backup with Sesame search on set the dock bar to the Sesame app, even without Sesame installed. The dock bar now uses Google whenever its search app isn't installed.
- **Iconography → Dock has the dock icon size again.** It had been left under the dock's style settings.
- **The feed reconnects after TheLauncher Feed is installed or updated.** Before, it kept the old, broken link until TheLauncher restarted.
- **Feed provider: Google isn't listed twice.** With TheLauncher Feed installed, picking Google already goes through it, so the list shows TheLauncher Feed only.
